ValidationRule.description: Prevents users other than System Admins from creating an Opportunity with a Potential Drive Date (Drive_Date__c) before TODAY
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(Drive_Date__c) && Drive_Date__c < TODAY() && Is_Template__c = false && $Profile.Name != 'System Administrator'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Drives may not be scheduled for dates prior to today's date.
